research_question: Does any topology-admissible finite-width Euler trefoil initialized from Gilbert 3:1:1 support a stationary/relative-stationary stable state and a finite mechanically transferred force threshold that remains knot-size independent?
objective: Adversarially distinguish relative-equilibrium, bounded finite-time perturbations, solver consistency, and actual load-to-failure. Separate full-fluid shear loading from knot-transferred reaction force.
null_hypothesis: H0: Within preregistered seed/core/shape family no verified stable relative equilibrium and no finite intrinsic knot load threshold. Short-time shape persistence does not reject H0.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: A validated relative equilibrium or relative periodic orbit remains stable to independent perturbations, preserves 3_1 topology, has a converged externally measured knot-mediated failure force, and that force limit does not vary with geometric knot scale under a fixed independently justified protocol.
assumptions: 3D incompressible inviscid Euler on periodic cube 6m per side, no viscosity; imposed balanced shear forcing for load studies only
Initial vorticity is compact-C2 mollified closed-curve tangent distribution, projected divergence-free; Fourier truncation produces noncompact tails
Numerics are pseudo-spectral rotational and independent convective Euler forms with 2/3 de-aliasing and RK4
Rigid fit removes translation, rotation, tangential marker gauge, but a marker residual does not prove stationary distributed-vorticity flow
No target force constants or G enter discovery code; physical SST values not scaled into model normalized units
3_1 topological and material core identification during evolution not independently qualified; source independence unverified

steps.operation: Check exact Gilbert Fourier seed source SHA and geometry
Deposit finite-width vorticity; solve spectral Euler with pressure Poisson crosscheck, rotational/advective parity
Target-free 9-case search over core radius and z aspect then independent 330-trial topology-constrained exploration, compare held-out grids
Independent plus/minus z2/x3 material curve perturbations and time-domain separation relative to control
Local native CPP parity on full Euler solver, not copied framework kernel
Fixed physical final time, grid and dt refinement, separate single-source versus second provenance family
Balanced 3D shear load, monitor force injection and momentum flux; do not call a maximum until convergence and a stable knot reaction

falsification_criteria.criterion: No candidate with relative equilibrium error <=0.05 within prespecified geometry search and independent grid
No measured knot-specific threshold: external shear is not a knot clamp/transducer
Core underresolved or spatial/temporal convergence missing

edge_cases: B-periodic domain changes global topology and pressure reference
Projecting vorticity changes compact support slightly
Material tracers do not certify knotted vorticity ridges
Shear forcing pumps energy: energy conservation must only be scored for unforced runs
Numerical filter enforces a cutoff and is not explicit molecular viscosity
Finite-time bounded perturbation may mask late instability
Ideal Fourier centerline has minimum ropelength, not force-balance
predictions: If a qualified force ceiling is intrinsic, it must survive changes in grid, kernel, load geometry, time horizon, and knot size at controlled circulation
If scale invariance follows Euler similarity only, force scales as rho Gamma squared and cannot by itself establish an ultimate ceiling
